title: Redo command center for usability
goal: Improve the Next.js worksheet command center usability by reducing cognitive load, making the primary generate-preview-export flow obvious, and preserving the JSON-first worksheet compiler.
context: The previous command-center implementation exposed too many controls at once and made the worksheet preview compete with setup and audit panels. The redo should follow the impeccable product UI register: familiar controls, restrained visual design, predictable layout, fewer simultaneous decisions, and task-first hierarchy.
acceptance: The desktop UI has a clear primary flow: teacher intent, tuning controls, live worksheet preview, review/export actions
The preview is visually cleaner and resembles the final worksheet before digital checking controls are expanded
Generator selection is searchable and less cognitively heavy than the previous full control wall
Review and export actions are visible without forcing users to discover a hidden tab
Mobile keeps a step workflow with concise labels and usable action placement
Worksheet JSON schema and deterministic generation remain unchanged
Frontend tests and required checks pass
notes: Do not add auth, accounts, databases, AI APIs, LMS integration, or non-JSON worksheet content paths.
